common_learner_errors: treating every initial م/ت as a root letter or every one as an augment
reading sound-plural tails (ون/ات) as radicals
forcing three visible radicals onto weak-root surfaces
corpus_pvn_application: letter-level colouring of every rich-hover token; p007-style clitic carving
exceptions: weak roots hide radicals from the surface (ماء: third radical absent)
geminate roots collapse two radicals under shadda
hamzat al-wasl belongs to the template, not the root
formation_or_decision_procedure: strip clitics conservatively (never invent a false stem)
recover root via the evidence ladder (entry -> QAC -> source -> adapter -> heuristic-last)
fit the wazn template; map each stem letter to root slot or augment
classify remaining affixes as inflection or clitic
abstain (pending_letter_ownership) on any unowned or doubly-owned letter
negative_conditions: initial م is NOT presumptively an augment
surface shape alone never assigns ownership
positive_conditions: every base letter owned exactly once
root certified by ladder, not by shape
recognition_criteria: token has a recoverable consonantal skeleton after removing known clitics
candidate root letters survive in a known wazn slot mapping (ف-ع-ل positions)
residual letters match a documented augment inventory (م، ت، ا، ن، ي، س، همزة الوصل)
required_evidence: certified root (evidence ladder)
documented wazn inventory
rich_hover_component: letter-ownership colour segments + per-segment gloss_contribution

common_learner_errors: reading form II shadda as emphasis of form I rather than a distinct lexeme
assuming causative meaning from form shape without entry support

contrasts.discriminator: shadda vs hamza augment; distinct lexemes of one root

corpus_pvn_application: verb-entry occurrences where form disambiguates the lexeme
exceptions: form VIII ت assimilates after د/ذ/ز/ص/ض/ط/ظ (اِزْدَادَ، اِصْطَبَرَ)
form IV hamza drops in the imperfect (يُنْزِلُ not يُؤَنْزِلُ)
formation_or_decision_procedure: identify augment signature over the certified root
confirm with the imperfect vowel pattern
select the form's sense profile from the entry, never from the form label alone
negative_conditions: a form label never fixes the sense (form II is not always causative)
identical surface skeletons across forms (نزل family) are not one verb
positive_conditions: form assignment consistent with BOTH perfect and imperfect shapes
recognition_criteria: stem augmentation pattern matches a form signature (shadda=II, alif=III, hamza=IV, ت prefixes=V/VI, ن=VII, ت infix=VIII, س ت=X)
vowel skeleton matches the form's perfect/imperfect template
required_evidence: sarf/rules/verb-measures.json paradigm
entry sense data
rich_hover_component: form label + augment-letter colouring + sense-selection note

common_learner_errors: glossing participles as verbs
reading مُـ as a root letter
assuming active voice when harakat are absent
corpus_pvn_application: n-entry participles; مُـ-initial tokens in example ayat
exceptions: weak-root participles deform the template (قَاضٍ from ق ض ي)
some مَفْعُول forms lexicalized as plain nouns
formation_or_decision_procedure: identify the participle template over the certified root
read the penult vowel on مُـ participles BEFORE glossing
gloss nominally (agent/patient noun), never as a finite verb
negative_conditions: a participle never takes a finite-verb gloss
penult vowel unread -> pending, never a guess
positive_conditions: template + vowel reading agree
nominal gloss shape
recognition_criteria: form-I shapes فَاعِل (active) / مَفْعُول (passive)
derived-form participles: مُـ prefix + imperfect stem; penult kasra=active, fatha=passive
required_evidence: template inventory + harakah on the penult (or abstention)
rich_hover_component: participle-class label + penult-vowel evidence note

common_learner_errors: treating any فِعَال-shape as a masdar
generating form-I masdars by analogy
corpus_pvn_application: n-entry masdars in example ayat
exceptions: مُفَاعَلَة alternates with فِعَال (قِتَال/مُقَاتَلَة)
form IV masdar إِفْعَال vs form I events colliding in skeleton
formation_or_decision_procedure: for forms II-X, derive the masdar from the form template
for form I, require entry/lexicon attestation — never generate
gloss as an event/state noun, not an infinitive verb chain
negative_conditions: a form-I masdar guess without attestation
verbal gloss on a masdar
positive_conditions: derived-form masdar matches its form template
recognition_criteria: form-I masdars are lexical (sama'i) — no single template
derived-form masdars are regular (تَفْعِيل، إِفْعَال، مُفَاعَلَة، تَفَعُّل، اِفْتِعَال، اِسْتِفْعَال)
required_evidence: form template (II-X) or explicit attestation (I)
rich_hover_component: masdar-class label + form linkage

common_learner_errors: reading the م as radical
assuming place meaning for every مَفْعَل token
concept: nouns of place, time and instrument

contrasts.discriminator: م vowel: fatha place/time vs kasra instrument

corpus_pvn_application: n-entries of these classes; pilot tokens مَسْجِد/مَكْتَب
exceptions: imperfect-stem vowel decides مَفْعَل vs مَفْعِل (يَجْلِسُ -> مَجْلِس)
lexicalized exceptions (مَغْرِب by convention)
formation_or_decision_procedure: certify the root
match the م-template
assign the م to the pattern
select place vs time by lexis/context; instrument by the مِـ kasra
negative_conditions: initial-م words whose م is radical (مَلِك، مَاء) are NOT this class
positive_conditions: template fit + root certified
recognition_criteria: templates مَفْعَل / مَفْعِل (place/time), مِفْعَل / مِفْعَلَة / مِفْعَال (instrument)
initial م + certified triliteral root fills the template
required_evidence: certified root + template inventory
rich_hover_component: pattern-augment colouring (the pilot's exact case)

common_learner_errors: reading the long alif of hollow verbs as a radical alif
extracting two-letter roots from doubled verbs (رَدَّ -> ر د د not ر د)
concept: weak, hamzated and doubled verb classes
corpus_pvn_application: v-entries with weak roots (large fraction of the corpus)
exceptions: doubly-weak (لفيف) combine two transformations
hamzated verbs change seat by environment without changing the radical
formation_or_decision_procedure: identify the weak position from the certified root, not the surface
apply the class's surface transformations (long-vowel replacement, radical loss, shadda collapse)
never let the surface veto a ladder-certified root
negative_conditions: surface-only root extraction on weak classes is forbidden
norm() output never certifies a weak root
positive_conditions: class assignment from certified root position
recognition_criteria: a radical is و/ي (assimilated=R1, hollow=R2, defective=R3), hamza, or R2=R3 (doubled)
required_evidence: evidence-ladder root; class tables
rich_hover_component: hidden-radical note in hover (letter counts differ from radical counts)

common_learner_errors: memorizing surfaces without the derivation, so novel forms fail
applying i'lal where the environment blocks it (صَيْد stays)
corpus_pvn_application: weak-root v-entries; recitation-variant boundaries stay out of scope
exceptions: qalb (قَلْب) vs hadhf (حَذْف) vs iskan outcomes differ per environment
ibdal in form VIII is conditioned by the FIRST radical's emphasis/voicing
formation_or_decision_procedure: state the underlying form from root + template
apply the documented transformation chain
verify the attested surface equals the chain output
negative_conditions: ad-hoc 'letters changed' explanations without a rule chain
positive_conditions: chain derivable from documented rules
recognition_criteria: a weak radical or hamza surfaces transformed (waw->alif after fatha; form-VIII ت voicing after emphatics)
required_evidence: documented transformation inventory + attested surface
rich_hover_component: transformation-note field (why the surface differs from the root)

common_learner_errors: linking broken plurals to singulars by surface similarity
treating ة as always-feminine-marker semantics
concept: number and gender morphology (duals, sound/broken plurals)
corpus_pvn_application: n-entry plural surfaces across example ayat
exceptions: non-human plurals take feminine-singular agreement
some feminines carry no marker (سماعي)
formation_or_decision_procedure: match tail inventory for sound forms (tails are morphology, never root)
match broken plurals via entry/lemma linkage, never by surface shape
read gender from entry data, not from the tail
negative_conditions: a sound-plural tail read as radicals
gender guessed from shape
positive_conditions: tail or template + entry linkage
recognition_criteria: dual ان/ين tails; sound masculine ون/ين; sound feminine ات; broken plurals by internal template
required_evidence: entry plural/gender fields; QAC lemma
rich_hover_component: number/gender chip + singular-linkage note

common_learner_errors: splitting a radical off as a false clitic
reading ـًا as the pronoun نا
corpus_pvn_application: the false-clitic-split eval bank (130 rows) + p002/p007 occurrence carving
exceptions: fused ال after ل (لِلَّهِ drops the alif)
orthographic seats shift under cliticization
formation_or_decision_procedure: peel proclitics outside-in against the closed inventory
verify a real stem remains (never invent a false stem)
identify enclitic pronouns from the closed set; tanwin-alef is NOT نا
classify remaining prefixes/suffixes as inflection
negative_conditions: peeling that leaves a non-word
clitic assignment by mere letter identity
positive_conditions: every peeled layer from a closed inventory + surviving attested stem
recognition_criteria: proclitics و/ف/ب/ل/ك/س/ال stack before the stem; enclitic pronouns after; verb inflection wraps the stem
required_evidence: closed clitic/pronoun inventories; morphology lattice agreement
rich_hover_component: multi-segment carving with per-segment roles (p007 pilot discipline)

common_learner_errors: reading tanwin as part of the word
treating فتحة as always-object marking
correct case label justified by the wrong governor (right-answer-wrong-reason)
concept: case and mood: the i'rab system
corpus_pvn_application: every iʿrāb-bearing occurrence decision (two-vote plane)
exceptions: diptotes take fatha for jarr UNLESS definite/mudaf (then kasra returns)
indeclinable (مبني) words carry a fixed shape with positional (محلّ) case
formation_or_decision_procedure: identify the inflection site (last radical or tail letters)
read the attested marking; if unpointed, mark unknown — never infer from role alone
connect marking to a governor via an explicit justification rule
case/mood conclusions carry the two-vote gate (conclusion AND reason)
negative_conditions: case assignment from word order alone
mood claims on unpointed text
positive_conditions: visible marking + named governor + justification rule
recognition_criteria: short-vowel endings (or letter endings on duals/plurals/five nouns) vary with syntactic role
imperfect verbs vary indicative/subjunctive/jussive under governors
required_evidence: visible marking + governor identification; two independent checks
rich_hover_component: case/mood chip with governor + reason (never a bare label)

common_learner_errors: swapping the kana/inna case patterns
treating أنّ and إنّ as interchangeable
missing the khabar when it precedes (جار ومجرور fronting)
corpus_pvn_application: p011/p012/p024/p029/p061/p063 occurrences; kana-family verb entries
exceptions: ما الحجازية partially mimics ليس (school-dependent)
لا النافية للجنس builds its noun on fatha (a different regime, not inna-nasb)
formation_or_decision_procedure: identify the abrogator and its family
kana: ism stays raf', khabar -> nasb; inna: ism -> nasb, khabar stays raf'; zanna: both -> nasb
locate BOTH governed elements before asserting either
emit candidate edges with justification; two-vote for certification
negative_conditions: assigning inna-government to لَكِنْ العاطفة (lightened, non-governing uses)
khabar case asserted without finding the ism
positive_conditions: family membership + both elements located
recognition_criteria: a nominal sentence preceded by كان-family (verb) or إنّ-family (particle) or ظنّ-family (double-accusative verb)
required_evidence: family membership tables + both governed elements + two-vote
rich_hover_component: abrogator card: family, ism, khabar, case effects with reasons

common_learner_errors: nearest-word-governs heuristics
confusing the governed element of nested constructs
corpus_pvn_application: all occurrence-level dependency analysis; scholar_irab_review routing
exceptions: multiple governors compete for one dependent (tanazu')
abstract governors (ibtida') are school-dependent objects
formation_or_decision_procedure: for each marked word, enumerate candidate governors in range
test each against a closed justification-rule inventory
keep ALL admissible edges in the lattice until evidence collapses them
governor edges are never auto_safe
negative_conditions: governor asserted without a rule
lattice collapsed by preference
positive_conditions: justified edge from the closed rule inventory
recognition_criteria: every case/mood marking is licensed by an identifiable governor (verb, particle, construct head, or abstraction)
required_evidence: dependency-lattice machinery; two-vote for iʿrāb conclusions
rich_hover_component: governor card with rel_label + justification + alternatives when unresolved

common_learner_errors: labelling every nasb noun as maf'ul bihi
hal vs tamyiz confusion
missing the mahdhuf verb of the maf'ul mutlaq pattern
corpus_pvn_application: accusative tokens across example ayat; tamyiz/hal pending classes
exceptions: istithna' case flips by sentence polarity and connectedness
munada takes nasb when mudaf but binaa on damm when a bare proper noun
formation_or_decision_procedure: confirm the nasb marking
enumerate which mansub roles the construction admits
discriminate by the role's own criteria (indefinite participle-like -> hal candidate; measure/number ambiguity -> tamyiz; إلا -> istithna')
unresolved multi-role -> preserve alternatives, pending
negative_conditions: role assigned from nasb alone (nasb is shared by ALL these roles)
positive_conditions: role criteria met + governor identified
recognition_criteria: accusative-marked non-subject roles: مفعول به/مطلق/فيه/لأجله/معه، حال، تمييز، مستثنى، منادى

rich_hover_component: role chip with the discriminating question + governor

common_learner_errors: dropping the 'a'id where required
agreement mismatch on dual/plural relatives
confusing relative مَا with negation مَا
corpus_pvn_application: p094-p098 occurrences; مَا/مَنْ multifunction guard
exceptions: 'a'id omission licensed for connected object pronouns (الذي رأيتُ)
مَن/مَا relatives are invariant (no agreement morphology)
formation_or_decision_procedure: match the relative to the head (gender/number)
locate the 'a'id (may be omitted when a connected object pronoun)
assign the clause its mahall (position-case) relative to the head
an indefinite head takes a sifa clause instead (no relative pronoun)
negative_conditions: treating الذي as interrogative
requiring an overt 'a'id where omission is licensed
positive_conditions: agreement + 'a'id located (or licensed omission)
recognition_criteria: a definite head + الذي-family (or مَن/مَا) + a clause containing a resumptive pronoun
required_evidence: agreement + 'a'id resolution; referent guard for pronouns
rich_hover_component: relative-chain card: head -> relative -> 'a'id trace

common_learner_errors: reading إنْ الشرطية as إنَّ
missing the ف on non-verbal apodoses
treating إذا as always temporal
corpus_pvn_application: p014/p017/p060/p033/p100 occurrences
exceptions: apodosis of لو takes ل frequently but not always
إذا الفجائية is NOT conditional (a homograph regime)
formation_or_decision_procedure: identify the particle and its regime (jussive for إنْ-class; لو counterfactual; إذا temporal-conditional)
locate BOTH clauses
check apodosis ف requirement (jumla ismiyya, talab, etc.)
read mood effects on both verbs for jazima particles
negative_conditions: mood claims when the apodosis is elliptical and unmarked
positive_conditions: particle + both clauses + regime consistency
recognition_criteria: a conditional particle (إنْ jazima، إذا، لو، مَن/مَا الشرطية...) + protasis + apodosis
required_evidence: particle regime tables + clause structure; two-vote for mood facts
rich_hover_component: conditional-pair card: particle, both clauses, mood regime

common_learner_errors: glossing مَا as 'what' everywhere
reading مَنْ 'who' as مِنْ 'from'
assuming لا prohibition on any لا + imperfect
corpus_pvn_application: p099 (مَا) and p100/p034 (مَنْ/مِنْ) occurrence universes
exceptions: مَا الكافة neutralizes government (إنَّمَا)
مَا الزائدة adds no clause function
الحجازية government is school-dependent
formation_or_decision_procedure: enumerate the particle's documented function inventory
apply per-function discriminators (following verb tense, clause type, apodosis, referent)
if more than one function survives, PRESERVE alternatives — pending, never default
مَا specifically: negation/relative/interrogative/masdariyya/shartiyya/kaffa/zaida each need positive evidence

positive_conditions: exactly one function survives its discriminators
recognition_criteria: one surface (مَا، مَنْ، لَا، وَ...) admits several function classes; the class is decided per occurrence
required_evidence: per-occurrence discriminator evidence; attributed-unresolved for genuine splits
rich_hover_component: function-inventory hover: taught functions + the discriminator that decides

common_learner_errors: treating the hidden element as recoverable text
inventing deletions to save a parse

exceptions: some deletions are obligatory (mustatir in imperative), some optional
reconstruction wording is analysis, not text — scripture is never altered
formation_or_decision_procedure: detect the licensing construction (imperative -> mustatir anta; jawab omission after evident context...)
state the reconstructed element as a TYPED hidden node (never as if visible)
mark reconstruction confidence; alternatives preserved when reconstructions rival
negative_conditions: free-form 'understood word' insertions without a licensing rule
positive_conditions: a licensed construction + typed reconstruction
recognition_criteria: meaning requires an element with no surface exponent: mustatir pronoun, omitted mubtada'/khabar, deleted verb of ya' vocative, elided 'a'id, apodosis ellipsis

rich_hover_component: hidden-element chip: typed, flagged as reconstruction, never coloured as text

common_learner_errors: expecting visible case on مبني words
giving sila clauses a mahall
corpus_pvn_application: maqsur nouns + clausal-position occurrences
exceptions: clauses after definite heads = sifa (no mahall dispute); after indefinite = hal — the pair inverts by definiteness
some clauses have NO mahall (isti'nafiyya, sila)
formation_or_decision_procedure: decide declinable vs mabni vs impossible-marking (maqsur)
for mabni/clausal: assign fi mahall X from the container construction
for maqsur/defective: assign muqaddar marking with the blocking reason (تعذّر/ثقل)
never report a mahall/muqaddar case as a visible marking
negative_conditions: mahall assigned to a fully declined word
muqaddar without a blocking reason
positive_conditions: container construction identified + marking-impossibility reason stated

required_evidence: clause-type inventory + container construction; two-vote for conclusions

common_learner_errors: attaching to the linearly nearest word
resolving referents by translation convenience

contrasts.b: PP attaches to a nominal head

exceptions: scope of negation over coordinated clauses is frequently genuinely ambiguous
jar-majrur attachment to a deleted kawn (khabar) is itself a taqdir analysis

apply agreement + adjacency + sense tests per site
resolve pronoun referents through the referent guard (divine-Name vs human attribute...)
unresolved -> preserve alternatives with the discriminating question
negative_conditions: nearest-head defaulting
referent carried across from a different occurrence
positive_conditions: a unique site/referent survives the tests
recognition_criteria: a modifier/prepositional phrase/pronoun admits more than one attachment site or referent; negation/exception operators have scope

common_learner_errors: presenting one school's analysis as the grammar
conflating ambiguity with dispute

contrasts.discriminator: does the disagreement change the dependency graph or only its justification?

corpus_pvn_application: scholar-lane rows (مَا 92:3:1 pattern); dependency-lattice alternatives

route genuine disputes to scholar/arbitration; NEVER vote or prefer

silent collapse to one analysis
positive_conditions: each parse individually rule-complete
